findings: Fixed all-correct-answers-last pattern; choices now use all positions, with stable retry order.
Word-part help now tells exactly which two parts to tap.
The picture selection after a sentence is word/context recognition, not a complete practical task.
The three source words are introduced before answer tasks. Nine source sentences remain labeled with support.
Completed with help or extra attempts schedules an in-block retry; merely watching a model is participation.
No full Alfa C coverage or independent-reading certification claimed.
Existing approved mobile demonstrations and all source media preserved.
Nine images previously visually reviewed; no image changes. Distant people in the bus photo have no clearly assessable fingers.
lessonPlan: Three short 10–15 minute practice blocks can be attached to the existing shopping, transport or home lesson goal. Actual scheduled session and independent learner performance remain for the teacher to establish; see updated manual chapter 2.
